guide.title: Install whisper-server and Ollama
guide.toggle: How to install whisper-server and Ollama
guide.intro: Run these on the computer that runs Live Subtitles. The commands already use its addresses, its models folder and the models new sessions use.
guide.allRunning: Both are running. The steps are here for a new install or another computer.
guide.modelsDirHint: Replace <models folder> with the server’s models folder: the --models-dir it was started with (./models by default).

macos.ollama: Start Ollama: open the Ollama app, or run this and keep the terminal open.
macos.whisper: Start whisper-server with the speech model {{whisper}} and keep the terminal open. It uses Metal, the Mac’s GPU, automatically.

linux.ollama: Install Ollama. It runs as a service, so it keeps running and starts with the computer.
linux.build: Build whisper.cpp from source. It needs git, CMake and a C++ compiler (on Debian or Ubuntu: sudo apt install git cmake build-essential). Or use the Docker steps instead.
linux.whisper: Start whisper-server from the whisper.cpp folder with the speech model {{whisper}} and keep the terminal open.

windows.ollama: Install Ollama with winget, or with the installer from https://ollama.com/download. It keeps running in the system tray.
windows.download: Download whisper-bin-x64.zip from https://github.com/ggml-org/whisper.cpp/releases and unzip it. Or use the Docker steps instead.
windows.whisper: Open PowerShell in the folder that has whisper-server.exe, start it with the speech model {{whisper}} and keep the window open.

docker.ollama: Start Ollama in a container. Its models stay in the ollama volume.
docker.whisper: Start whisper-server in a container with the speech model {{whisper}}.

step.models: Download the speech model {{whisper}} and the translation model {{gemma}} under Local models. Gemma downloads through Ollama, so start Ollama first.
step.check: Press “Check again” to confirm that both answer.

guide.gpu: The whisper.cpp image is for x86-64 computers and runs on the CPU. With an NVIDIA GPU, use the image ghcr.io/ggml-org/whisper.cpp:main-cuda and add --gpus all after docker run; it needs the NVIDIA Container Toolkit.
guide.gpuLinux: With an NVIDIA GPU, build with cmake -B build -DGGML_CUDA=1 instead; it needs the CUDA toolkit.
guide.dockerMac: Containers can’t use the Apple GPU, so on a Mac the macOS steps are faster.
guide.restart: whisper-server loads one model when it starts. After you download or choose a different speech model, stop it and start it again with that model’s file.
guide.addresses: If they run at other addresses, change them in Settings.
